name: Porcelain Repair River
description: A river flowing with liquid gold (kintsugi) that mends broken porcelain shores — cracked plates, shattered vases, fractured statues — healing them into more beautiful forms as the current carries golden repair.
prompt: River of molten gold kintsugi flowing through landscape of broken porcelain — cracked dinner plates form riverbanks, shattered vases create rapids, fractured statues stand as islands, the liquid gold seeps into every crack healing them with luminous seams, repaired pieces glow warmer than surroundings, cherry blossom petals fall onto gold-repaired surfaces, Japanese aesthetic, wabi-sabi philosophy visualized, serene peaceful atmosphere, 8k, aerial view showing river of gold healing the land
caption:
Broken isn't ruined. It's waiting for gold. 🌊✨

The cracks are where the light enters — and stays.
